# Resource: tfe_registry_provider

Manages public and private providers in the private registry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create private provider

resource "tfe_registry_provider" "example" {
  organization = tfe_organization.example.name

  name = "my-provider"
}
```

```terraform
# Create public provider

resource "tfe_registry_provider" "example" {
  organization = tfe_organization.example.name

  registry_name = "public"
  namespace     = "hashicorp"
  name          = "aws"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `Name` (String) Name of the provider.

### Optional

- `Namespace` (String) The namespace of the provider. Required if `RegistryName` is `Public`, otherwise it can't be configured, and it will be set to same value as the `Organization`.
- `Organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.
- `RegistryName` (String) Whether this is a publicly maintained provider or private. Must be either `Public` or `Private`.

### Read-Only

- `CreatedAt` (String) The time when the provider was created.
- `Id` (String) ID of the provider.
- `UpdatedAt` (String) The time when the provider was last updated.



## Import

tfe_registry_provider can be imported using an identity. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = tfe_registry_provider.test
  identity = {
    id            = "prov-kwt1cBiX2SdDz38w"
    organization  = "my-org-name"
    registry_name = "private"
    namespace     = "my-org-name"
    name          = "aws"
    hostname      = "app.terraform.io"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `Id` (String)
- `Name` (String)
- `Namespace` (String)
- `Organization` (String)
- `RegistryName` (String)

#### Optional

- `Hostname` (String)


Resource tfe_registry_provider can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <ORGANIZATION>/<REGISTRY NAME>/<NAMESPACE>/<PROVIDER NAME>
# For a private provider:
terraform import tfe_registry_provider.example my-org-name/private/my-org-name/my-provider

# For a public provider:
terraform import tfe_registry_provider.example my-org-name/public/hashicorp/aws
```
